g.text: DeFuzz: Invariant-Guided Agentic Testing of Compiler-Instrumented Defenses
Autonomous Invariant Distillation · Code Grounding & Log Probe · PBT Parameterized Fuzzing · Compiler Diagnostics & Dual-Path Adaptation
Deterministic Truth Oracles per Mechanism & Architecture
Check IBT endbr64 landing pads & BTI / PAC instructions
Sweep overflow offsets 1..4096 bytes via argv[2] to probe LR/FP
SIGABRT = Protected (Expected) vs SIGSEGV = Invariant Violated
Free Agent (e.g. Claude Code) + MCP Tooling Stack
Non-colliding Probe Injection at Critical Anchors
Allocates equal time budget T_inv & round budget per Invariant Target.
Synthesizes Parameterized C/C++ Test Harnesses (Aware of Invariant & Checker)
• Checker Protocol Definition • Static/Dynamic One-Shot Templates • Guidance
main(argc, argv) accepts dynamic size & sweep probe offsets
Target Compiler compiles Seed $ ightarrow$ Collects Diagnostics & Logs
Canary intact or trap triggered correctly (SIGABRT)
Canary bypassed to return address (SIGSEGV) / Missing Symbol
Preconditions unfulfilled or frame optimized out
Aggregates Compiler Diagnostics & Unique-ID Trace Stream
Inter-Tier Self-Healing on Persistent Oracle/Precondition Flaws
1. Analyzes compiler diagnostic traces & failed probe assumptions
2. Synthesizes patched Checker code (Static symbol / Dynamic offset)
3. Grounding Gate Re-Verification: Validates on baseline test set
4. Replaces catalog entry in Blackboard with new version tag
$ ightarrow$ Resumes seed generation with zero goalpost drift
Persists Confirmed PoC + Steers Generator for Variant Mining
• Target: GCC 13.2 AArch64 Frame Layout (CVE-2023-4039 Class)
• Root Cause: VLA dynamic stack allocation placed above canary slot
• Observable Effect: Crafted payload bypasses canary directly to LR
• PoC Artifact: Minimized Seed + Reproducible Compiler Flags
↔️ Lateral Thinking Guidance (横向发散探索):
When a bug is confirmed, guide Generator to explore:
• Orthogonal syntax variants (alloca vs VLA vs dynamic struct array)
• Multiple nested function frames & non-local goto labels
$ ightarrow$ Exploits maximum vulnerability surface under same invariant
Target: IEEE S&P / USENIX Security / ACM CCS / NDSS
